column4: Fix scripts/mesh-exit-node-lan-heal's LAN predicate for locally connected RFC6598 prefixes. Current read-only evidence (2026-09-14 05:26Z): enp42s0 owns 100.76.27.91/16; main has 100.76.0.0/16 dev enp42s0 and default via 100.76.0.1, while table 52 resolves 100.76.0.1 via tailscale0. mesh-card --exit-node-lan reports SWALLOWED; mesh-exit-node-lan-heal --check exits 1, refusing 100.76.0.0/16 because ipaddress.is_private says it is not RFC1918. Change the predicate to require exact live connected-route/interface/address evidence before admitting a CGNAT LAN prefix; do not blanket-allow 100.64/10, an unconnected CGNAT prefix, public ranges, or stale configured prefixes. Preserve more-specific Tailscale peer routes. Add fixtures for connected 100.76.0.0/16 acceptance, unconnected/stale/public/non-owned rejection, peer-route precedence, idempotence, dry-run no-write, and loud refusal. Run mesh-exit-node-lan-heal --test and bash -n; record source/test hashes and explicitly state no real route was written. Supersedes the code intent of rejected exit-node-lan-cgnat-repair-20260912/repair-cgnat-lan-healer only with this fresh live-prefix evidence.

After the connected-CGNAT guard lands, re-derive the current connected prefix, gateway, interface, main-table default, and table-52 peer routes at dispatch time; do not reuse 100.76.0.0/16 if it has changed. Follow docs/coordination.md before any routing write: detect active operators, claim routing on mesh-trace with invariant and rollback, coordinate holds through tmux/mesh-tell, inspect mesh-dms --list, arm the exact rollback before mutation, and apply only the verified local connected prefix throw in table 52. Verify the gateway's FIB device returns to the local interface, tailnet peer /32 routes still use tailscale0, host default/e2e reachability is preserved, and mesh-card --refresh plus mesh-health pass before cancelling rollback; leave a failure artifact and do not cancel DMS on any failed gate.

Independently verify deployed/source identity, actual reflex wiring and freshness, the re-derived LAN gateway FIB path, unchanged tailnet peer routes, host egress/reachability, mesh-card --refresh, and mesh-health after vpn's repair. Record exact commands and artifacts; close only if all route and reachability invariants pass, otherwise keep the step blocked with the precise retry condition. This step must not repeat or perform vpn's route write.
